messages:
jana_sales: Aurora Capital returned the SIG v2 and marked Q17-Q20 as gating. They want per-question attachments + a 1-2 sentence non-technical answer. Can we split quickly?

leo_se: I can take Q17 (tenant isolation) and Q20 (network segmentation). Need a redacted tenancy diagram and an Envoy snippet.

mira_security: I'll take Q18 (KMS & rotation) and Q19 (encryption at rest/in-transit). I have a rotation excerpt and encryption summary we can use.

oliver_ps: I'll pull SOC2 controls excerpt and the dataflow narrative. Also can attach a POC screenshot showing tenant filtering.

artifact_bot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/tenancy_diagram_aurora_v1.pdf|tenancy_diagram_aurora_v1.pdf> (520KB)

leo_se: Thanks. For the snippet, Aurora asked for YAML. I'll paste a sanitized example here and then push to the shared folder: 
```yaml
# sanitized per-tenant routing
virtual_hosts:
  - name: tenant-aurora-demo
    routes:
      - match: /tenant/aurora-demo/*
        cluster: rwinf-tenant-aurora-demo
```

leo_se: Will redact hostnames and obvious IDs before upload.

mira_security: For KMS, reference our HSM-backed provider and rotation cadence. I'll attach `kms_rotation_excerpt.md` and a short BYOK note for Private deployments.

oliver_ps: Uploaded SOC2 excerpt and dataflow: <https://files.redwood.internal/soc2_aurora_excerpt.pdf|soc2_aurora_excerpt.pdf>, <https://files.redwood.internal/dataflow_aurora.md|dataflow_aurora.md>

artifact_bot: File uploaded: <https://files.redwood.internal/poc_tenant_filter_aurora.png|poc_tenant_filter_aurora.png> (140KB)

jana_sales: Can each of you drop final filenames for the bundle and a 1-2 sentence plain-English blurb we can paste into the SIG? I'll assemble and run a quick redaction pass.

leo_se: Filenames: `/shared/sales-aurora/tenancy_diagram_redacted.pdf`, `/shared/sales-aurora/envoy_tenant_snippet.yaml`

leo_se: Plain English: "Each tenant's traffic is routed using tenant-specific proxy rules that map to isolated runtime clusters and separate cache namespaces to prevent cross-tenant access."

mira_security: Filenames: `/shared/sales-aurora/kms_rotation_excerpt.md`, `/shared/sales-aurora/byok_support_note.txt`

mira_security: Plain English: "Keys are stored in an HSM-backed KMS with automated rotations; Private deployments support customer-managed keys (BYOK) via standard KMS APIs."

oliver_ps: Filenames: `/shared/sales-aurora/soc2_excerpt.pdf`, `/shared/sales-aurora/dataflow_narrative.md`, `/shared/sales-aurora/poc_tenant_filter.png`

oliver_ps: Plain English: "SOC2 controls cover access and change controls; the dataflow document explains how data moves through proxy, runtime, and storage layers."

jana_sales: Two quick asks: 1) ensure all hostnames/account IDs are redacted, 2) add a one-line caption to the screenshot describing what it demonstrates.

leo_se: Will redact and add caption: "Dashboard filtered to tenant 'aurora-demo' showing runtime metrics (no PII)."

mira_security: Added rotation cadence note to the KMS doc: "Rotation cadence: 90 days (automated); audit logs enabled."

jana_sales: Great. I'm packaging this up now and will aim to send the ZIP to Aurora by tomorrow morning. If anything changes, ping here. Thanks :thumbsup:
